about_the_game:
Welcome to Anton. The year is 1997, and something ancient is stirring beneath the city streets.

Valince Genesis: VR is a short, story-driven horror experience designed for virtual reality. Set in the gritty underbelly of a fictional American state, you step into the boots of Marcus, an elite vampire enforcer from the secretive A.N.G.E.L. order. Your mission is simple: retrieve a dangerous serum known as Genesis before it falls into the wrong hands.

But nothing in Anton is ever simple.

Explore run-down alleys, locked-down gun stores, and shadowy sewer tunnels as you uncover the truth behind a betrayal that could shift the balance of vampire power forever. Solve puzzles, find hidden crests, and follow a blood trail that leads straight to Eve Manor—home of a rogue scientist with a twisted vision for the future of mankind.

This standalone VR prologue sets the stage for the larger Valince Genesis desktop game. Featuring environmental storytelling, creepy encounters, and light puzzle-solving, it’s a compact but haunting experience designed to introduce players to the world of Valince.

content_descriptors.notes: It is a found footage vampire game.  Warning: there is intense violence and very limited nudity that is only found within in-game  comics.
